organs.purpose: Assigns semantic roles and stable hierarchy tokens instead of one-off text styling.
Adapts text to viewport, pixel density, viewing distance, and user scaling.
Measures contrast and adds protective layers when the background is unsafe or dynamic.
Creates readable foreground separation using plates, gradients, blur, and local scrims.
Builds effects in ordered layers so decoration never destroys the glyph core.
Routes tiny, normal, scalable, and transformed text to suitable raster/SDF/MSDF strategies.
Protects shaping, fallback fonts, expansion, direction, and script coverage.
Adds purposeful text motion with reduced-motion fallbacks and readability timing.
Optimizes numbers, counters, prices, timers, and tables.
Defines stress tests for scale, backgrounds, localization, and screenshot drift.
Checks casing, length, density, labels, and concise action wording.
Maps one resolved text plan into platform-specific implementation hints.
Maps moods such as gold, silver, chrome, neon metal, and holographic into gradient, bevel, sheen, and sparkle treatments without sacrificing readability.
Controls moving or static highlight sweeps so special text feels alive without becoming noisy or unreadable.
Applies restrained channel offsets, jitter, and distortion rules so futuristic glitch text stays readable and does not become messy or inaccessible.
Routes premium text effects toward engine-native shader/material implementations so glow, sheen, metal, and glitch remain modular and reusable.
Packages safe combinations of semantic role, visual recipe, surface protection, and effect tuning into discoverable reusable presets.
Scales blur, glow, shadow, sheen, sparkle, motion, and glitch cost to target hardware without silently changing semantic text roles.
Lets humans create, import, replace, delete, and export local presets without modifying the built-in catalog.
Makes compiled text bundles verifiable, reconstructable, and disposable without mutating canonical source.
Compiles multiple presets into a navigable, verified platform library for reuse across many games, apps, and software surfaces.
Inspects Unicode scripts, text direction, combining marks, hidden controls, replacement characters, private-use glyphs, and fallback requirements before visual effects are applied.
Bakes a portable SVG representation from the exact resolved text plan, with optional PNG rendering for software, game, marketing, or temporary fallback use.
Generates comparable assets across presets, recipes, and render quality tiers so visual drift and over-expensive effects are inspectable before intake.
Parses project-owned TTF, OTF, or TTC files directly and verifies that the chosen face contains every required character before effects are compiled.
Builds local metadata registries for project fonts, including names, hashes, Unicode coverage, variable axes, shaping tables, color-font support, and licensing metadata.
Selects a minimal ordered set of locally registered fonts that collectively covers the requested text.
Estimates line wrapping, overflow, safe-area use, and viewing-distance risks before text enters a target renderer.
Creates deterministic accented, expanded, and pseudo-RTL variants while preserving common placeholders and tags.
Applies platform-aware safe-area and minimum-size guidance for TV, console, handheld, mobile, desktop, VR, and world-space text.
